description:
Sends a test mail with the saved settings, at once and outside the queue, to the given address or to the signed-in user, in that user's language. At most 5 requests a minute. A failed send answers 400 with the (scrubbed) reply of the server in message_values.error.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

to.description: The recipient, one address; defaults to the signed-in user's address

200.description: The mail was handed to the server
